messages:
anya_ops: heads-up — EU2 hosted pool 'eu2-gpu-main' headroom dropped below 8% for the last 12m. p95 queueing ~2.8s and admission started rejecting low-priority jobs. grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/eu2-pool?panelId=9
mike_infra: on it. pulling admission and pool-fill logs now. can we overflow to dedicated-usw2 as temporary relief? that adds cross-region egress
sasha_platform: cross-region overflow will add ~200ms and costs. need explicit approval for egress + IAM rule.
julian_sre: quick question — is this traffic organic or partner-driven? if partner burst we should throttle tokens first
anya_ops: looks partner-driven; partner token 'fast-embed-v2' accounts for ~70% of the spike in the last 30m
capacity-bot: scale attempt: REQUEST -> +8 gpus in eu2; STATUS -> failed (quota_exceeded). project=hosted-eu2; request_id=scale-2178901
mike_infra: ugh quota. opening cloud quota escalation. in the meantime propose two mitigations: (1) token-scoped rate-limit for partner to 30 rps, (2) soft adjustment of admission threshold for low-priority from 0.75 -> 0.60 only if saturation continues. thoughts?
anya_ops: prefer token rate-limit first. changing admission thresholds impacts many tenants, keep as last-resort
sasha_platform: agree. i'll draft per-token rule and apply as low-latency config (no deploy). julian_sre: also suggest warming fallback model in routing table so we can failover gracefully if p99 > 5s
mike_infra: fallback present ('redwood-7b-ql') but not warmed. kicking warmup job: `kubectl apply -f jobs/warmup-eu2-fallback.yaml` (starting now)
sasha_platform: can we warm KV caches too? cold KV lookups add latency for some workloads
mike_infra: starting cache-warm job with warmup-keysets for top-10 partner prefixes; ETA ~4m
deploy-bot: warmup job started (job/warmup-eu2-2167) status=running
anya_ops: quick note: partner traffic correlates with a marketing campaign — spike sustained for 30m. tagging @finance — this will impact GPU spend if it keeps up
finance: noted. please add estimated delta to the quota ticket and we'll review temporary chargebacks
julian_sre: triage checklist: if headroom < 6% for another 10m run EU2-saturation-escalation playbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/ops/eu2-saturation
mike_infra: applied token rate-limit for 'fast-embed-v2' (30 rps) at edge and adjusted admission weights to deprioritize 'low' tokens in queue. immediate effect: low-priority rejections down 45%, p95 reduced to ~1.6s. monitoring 10m
anya_ops: awesome. keep this thread active until the quota lifts or traffic subsides. open items: (A) quota request IT-3245 (B) postmortem with partner on rate-limit expectation (C) autoscaler sensitivity review.
mike_infra: creating IT-3245 and will attach graphs + cost delta. will follow up on autoscaler tuning tomorrow. :thumbsup:
anya_ops: thanks all — nice quick mitigation. once quota confirmed we'll consider a temporary dedicated spill or increasing autoscaler headroom. closing update pending quota.
